sources.role: settings database, EEPROM/nvram, basedir, slots and Time Machine
state file naming, state dir, per-OS base dirs (7.x line pinned by the contract)

paths.path: ~/.config/stella/stella.sqlite3 (plus stella.sqlite3-wal); SQLite settings store in the XDG config dir honored via XDG_CONFIG_HOME; -basedir <dir> relocates every configuration file
evidence: docs:index 'The database file is named stella.sqlite3 ... Linux/Unix $HOME/.config/stella/'

paths.path: ~/.config/stella/nvram/ - Atari 2600 game saves only exist for cart hardware with EEPROM: SaveKey and AtariVox EEPROM images live here; carts without EEPROM hardware keep progress only inside save states
paths.naming: Per-device, not per-ROM: atarivox_eeprom.dat and savekey_eeprom.dat, created on demand and initialized to all $FF like real EEPROM

paths.path: ~/.config/stella/state/ (defaultStateDir = 'state' under the base dir; the 'statedir' setting overrides; 'statewithrom' saves beside the ROM instead)
paths.naming: <Cart_Name>.st<slot> with slots 0..9 (.st0-.st9); Cart_Name is the ROM properties name; -autoslot advances (slot+1)%10 after saving; Time Machine adds interval auto-states; -saveonexit none|current|all
evidence: source:src/common/StateManager.cxx std::format("{}{}.st{}", stateDir, Cart_Name, slot) with slot clamped 0..9

paths.path: None - the Atari 2600 has no BIOS/firmware ROMs; Stella ships everything it needs (bankswitch and cart helper ROMs like Supercharger loading screens are emulated in code; -fastscbios only toggles the progress-bar display)
evidence: docs:index Features list (no firmware/system ROM requirement anywhere)
db:no firmware_rules rows exist for stella (none are needed)

linux.notes: Lunchbox launches with -basedir <session dir> (contract native_command) so the settings DB, nvram and state/ tree all land inside the private base directory; native saves stay there across launches.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/io.github.stella_emu.Stella/.config/stella/stella.sqlite3 (the sandbox gives the app its own HOME under ~/.var/app/<id>, so the same HOME-relative .config/stella layout lands there)
evidence: source:src/os/unix/OSystemUNIX.cxx XDG config dir resolution relative to $HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME

paths.path: ~/.var/app/io.github.stella_emu.Stella/.config/stella/nvram/ - SaveKey/AtariVox EEPROM images inside the sandbox HOME
paths.naming: atarivox_eeprom.dat and savekey_eeprom.dat, as on native Linux

paths.path: None - no BIOS/firmware, as on native Linux
evidence: db:no firmware_rules rows exist for stella

linux-flatpak.notes: Flathub build exists (io.github.stella_emu.Stella); Lunchbox's native Stella integration drives the binary with -basedir, which the Flatpak build also honors inside its sandbox.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\Stella\stella.sqlite3 (Roaming profile; -baseinappdir switches the base dir to the application directory, Windows-only)

paths.naming: atarivox_eeprom.dat and savekey_eeprom.dat, initialized to all $FF
evidence: source:src/emucore/OSystem.cxx nvram dir under base dir
